slides.title: Explore the fundamentals
slides.description: Courses in breathwork and meditation rooted in ancient texts. Learn timeless practices and gain tools you can apply independently in everyday life

slides.title: Control your breath
slides.description: Learn proper breathing patterns and pranayama (conscious breath control) to support your physical health, mental clarity, energy levels, immunity, and longevity

slides.title: Meditate with purpose
slides.description: 100+ guided meditations, from 10 minutes and up. For all levels — practices for focus, emotional balance, energy renewal, healing, restful sleep, memory improvement, etc.

slides.title: Practice what works for you
slides.description: Short tests help you find the meditation or breathing technique that best fits your current state. Tailor your path to your personal needs, right here, right now

slides.title: Relax in Yoga Nidra
slides.description: A yogic practice of deep rest and renewal. Enter the space between sleep and wakefulness, where observing the body and breath helps the nervous system reset and restore energy

slides.title: Observe your state
slides.description: Watch your emotional and mental states shift as you practice meditation. Recognizing emotions encourages emotional regulation as you move through them

slides.title: Move the body
slides.description: Prepare the body for seated postures used in meditation and breathwork. Or use the daily warm-up on its own to bring tone and vitality to your body

teachers.teacher1: Tati Frost — the co-founder and lead teacher at Patanjali International Yoga Foundation in Rishikesh, India (an accredited school with Yoga Alliance USA):  30 years of personal practice and 20 years of teaching experience, 10,000+ students worldwide. Students call her “a teacher of teachers”
teachers.teacher2: Matthew Wright — over two decades of meditation practice. Certified 500-hour yoga teacher. Leads sessions in yoga nidra, meditation, and Buddhist philosophy for global communities. A longtime student of Madhyamaka, a central school of Buddhist philosophy
